title: 2-slice toaster
descriptions: Two-slice toaster, works fine. Bagel setting and a crumb tray.
Red toaster, both slots heat evenly. Got a new one as a gift.

title: Signed football jersey #12
descriptions: Game-style jersey signed on the number. Comes with certificate of authenticity.
Autographed #12 jersey, never worn, kept in a closet in a garment bag. COA included.

title: 2011 Honda Civic LX, 168k miles
descriptions: Runs and drives. Clean title, new tires last year, AC blows cold. Some door dings.
Daily driver for 9 years. Oil changed every 5k, check engine light is a loose gas cap.

title: Mountain bike, 21-speed
descriptions: Medium frame, front suspension, shifts clean. Tires hold air.
Rode it maybe ten times. Disc brakes, 27.5 inch wheels.

title: Electric guitar with gig bag
descriptions: Solid body electric, plays great, new strings. Gig bag and cable included.
Strat-style guitar, a couple of small chips on the body. Stays in tune.

title: Purple three-seat couch
descriptions: Comfy three-seater, no stains, no pets. You haul it.
Bought two years ago, moving and it won't fit. Cushions are firm.

title: Stand mixer, 5 qt
descriptions: Tilt-head stand mixer with bowl, whisk, paddle and dough hook. Works perfectly.
Used for holiday baking only. All attachments included.

title: 12-cup drip coffee maker
descriptions: Programmable coffee maker, carafe has no cracks. Descaled last month.
Makes a full pot in about 8 minutes. Switched to a pour-over.

title: Mini fridge with freezer
descriptions: Dorm fridge, 3.1 cu ft, keeps drinks cold. Magnets not included.
Quiet mini fridge, small freezer box on top. Cleaned out.

title: Game console with controller
descriptions: Disc version, one controller, all cables. Factory reset.
Barely played, still has the stand. Comes with one controller.

title: Mid-century floor lamp
descriptions: Tall floor lamp with a yellow shade. Bulb included.
Floor lamp, brass-look pole, shade has no tears.

title: Ergonomic office chair
descriptions: Adjustable height and arms, rolls smooth. Mesh back.
Work-from-home chair, no rips, lumbar support still works.

title: Countertop microwave
descriptions: 1000 watt microwave, turntable spins, clean inside.
Works fine, just upgraded to an over-the-range one.

title: Dining table with two chairs
descriptions: Solid wood table, seats four, two matching chairs. Small scratch on top.
Farmhouse-style table and chairs. Must pick up, ground floor.

title: 10 ft sit-in kayak with paddle
descriptions: Stable sit-in kayak, great for lakes. Paddle included.
Used two summers, no leaks, some scratches on the hull.

title: Gas push lawn mower
descriptions: Starts on the second pull. Blade sharpened this spring.
21 inch push mower, bag included. Moved to a condo.

title: Acoustic guitar, full size
descriptions: Dreadnought acoustic, warm sound, a little buzz on the low E.
Good beginner guitar, comes with a strap and picks.

title: Record player with built-in speakers
descriptions: Plays 33 and 45. Wood case, needle replaced recently.
Turntable with speakers and Bluetooth. Lid has a small crack.

title: Complete skateboard
descriptions: 8 inch deck, new grip tape, wheels spin fast.
Skated a handful of times. Bearings are good.

title: Baby stroller with canopy
descriptions: Folds with one hand, canopy and basket. Washed the fabric.
Kid outgrew it. All wheels lock, no rips.

title: 5 qt air fryer
descriptions: Digital air fryer, basket is nonstick and clean.
Used a few times, too big for my counter.

title: 55" 4K smart TV
descriptions: 4K smart TV with remote and stand. No dead pixels.
Wall mount not included. Picture is great, upgrading to a bigger one.

title: Five-shelf bookcase
descriptions: Sturdy bookcase, about 6 ft tall. Books not included.
Wood-look bookshelf, some wear on the corners. Easy to take apart.

title: Monstera in ceramic pot
descriptions: Healthy monstera, about 3 ft tall, new leaf coming in. Pot included.
Big leafy plant, too big for my apartment. Coral pot included.

title: Running sneakers, size 10
descriptions: Worn twice, wrong size for me. Original box.
Lightweight running shoes, clean soles.

title: DSLR camera with kit lens
descriptions: 24MP DSLR, 18-55mm lens, battery, charger and strap. Low shutter count.
Great starter camera. Bag and a 64GB card included.

title: Folding treadmill
descriptions: Folds up, goes to 10 mph, incline works. You move it.
Treadmill in great shape, mostly a clothes rack lately.

title: 2009 250cc motorcycle
descriptions: Great first bike, 9k miles, new battery. Title in hand.
Runs strong, new chain and sprockets. Selling because I got a car.

title: Writing desk with drawers
descriptions: Desk with three drawers, about 4 ft wide. Laptop not included.
Solid desk, a few marks on top. Drawers slide fine.

title: Pair of 25 lb dumbbells
descriptions: Two 25 lb hex dumbbells, rubber coated. No cracks.
Pair of 25s, lightly used in a home gym.

title: Electric scooter
descriptions: Goes about 15 miles a charge, top speed 15 mph. Charger included.
Folding e-scooter, new tires, brakes adjusted.
